title: MassDOT releases rendering of two new bridges along McGrath Highway
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: MassDOT plans to replace Squires Bridge and add Somerville Avenue Extension Bridge on McGrath Highway.
The Squires Bridge will be a 300-foot single-span beam bridge, replacing the deteriorated existing structure.
Construction could start in 2030 with completion expected within three to four years.

title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ review: Peter Parker grows up in emotionally mature sequel
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' explores a more mature Peter Parker, highlighting his inner struggles in a gray New York City.
Zendaya's role expands with a sharper script, showcasing her chemistry with Tom Holland in the 2026 film.
The movie balances small-scale storytelling with cameo appearances, avoiding multiverse complexities typical of the MCU.

title: This Boston law firm is boosting starting salaries to $235,000
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: McDermott Will & Schulte LLP raises starting salary for first-year associates to $235,000 effective July 1.
McDermott is the first Boston firm to announce this salary level, aligning with firms like New York-based Milbank.
Boston is a major legal market, but no other local firms, including Ropes & Gray, have matched McDermott's salary increase.

title: Boston will host the second-ever National Urban Rat Summit
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Boston will host the National Urban Rat Summit on Sept. 23 and 24, gathering experts and leaders in pest control.
Mayor Michelle Wu announced the summit, emphasizing Boston's proactive approach using integrated pest management over traditional rodenticides.
Tufts University found Boston's rat-borne leptospirosis risk, prompting increased focus on effective rodent control strategies.

title: Mass. postal worker robbed at gunpoint
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A U.S. Postal Service employee was robbed at gunpoint outside a Billerica sorting facility.
The suspects took an arrow key from the employee and fled in a black Cadillac toward Chelmsford Street.
Arrow keys provide access to postal boxes and locked mail receptacles; Billerica Police are investigating.

title: Myrtle the sea turtle weighs nearly 500 pounds. What does it take to keep her healthy?
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Myrtle, a green sea turtle at the New England Aquarium, weighs nearly 500 pounds and receives regular health check-ups.
During exams, staff at the aquarium check the turtles for lesions, draw blood for testing, and perform ultrasounds.
Information from resident sea turtles aids in treating hundreds of cold-stunned turtles rehabilitated at the aquarium's Quincy facility.

title: New program aims to bring electric vehicles to Mass. communities
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The CommunityEV Carshare pilot, funded by a $1 million grant, offers EVs and solar-powered chargers in Boston, Chelsea, Framingham, and Quincy.
Zipcar provides EVs, while Always, VoloStar, and Beam Global supply solar charging infrastructure, avoiding lengthy construction for installation.
Eligible residents can rent electric vehicles at discounted rates, with fees covering insurance, charging, and maintenance through 2027.

title: Review & setlist: Tim McGraw started soft and finished strong at Fenway romp
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Tim McGraw performed at Fenway Park on July 30, 2026, starting with an acoustic set from his 'Pawn Shop Guitar' tour.
Opening acts included The Chicks, Lady A, 49 Winchester, and Timothy Wayne, adding to the evening's country music lineup.
McGraw concluded with 'Truck Yeah' as clouds parted over Fenway, leaving the audience in high spirits.

title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial: Duxbury police, ER doctors testify after jurors visit the crime scene
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Jurors visited key locations, including Clancy's former Duxbury home, before listening to witness testimonies in her murder trial.
Duxbury Police Officer Lippard testified about Clancy's unresponsive state and a 'code blue' at Brigham and Women's Hospital.
Doctors Tenerowicz and Kaufman described resuscitation efforts for Clancy's children; Dawson was declared dead, Callan had no brain function.

title: Jarren Duran’s latest incident with Red Sox includes bizarre outburst involving Willson Contreras
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jarren Duran had an outburst during the Red Sox win over the Athletics, involving teammate Willson Contreras.
Duran was frustrated after a failed play, leading to a dugout incident with a water pipe spray.
Despite tensions, Contreras and manager Chad Tracy downplayed the incident, emphasizing team unity.
